fields.label: Release ID
fields.description: Stable immutable identifier for this release.

fields.label: Compatibility and Lifecycle
fields.description: These declarations are part of the immutable release contract and are projected into the deployment manifest.

fields.label: Compatibility
fields.description: Closed compatibility declaration: helper_protocol, privilege_readiness_contract, docker_install_plan, docker_install_policy, inventory_schema and upgrade_from.

fields.label: Predecessor Provenance
fields.description: Immutable release identities and exact component fingerprints captured from verified Published or Retired predecessors during draft creation.

fields.label: Lifecycle
fields.description: Bootstrap, upgrade, reconciliation, activation order and verification semantics.

fields.label: Release Components
fields.description: The component rows define the release. SHA-256 values are calculated from actual local source files when a draft is saved.

fields.label: Aggregate SHA-256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the canonical, sorted component definitions.
